model_family: Three Gaussian-copula paired mechanisms with shared source normal/lognormal marginal distributions

evidence_use.operator: arithmetic means and sample SDs on complete endpoint pairs
evidence_use.population: 44 completers aged 7-14 with simple obesity; before/after 3-month home diet/exercise program with professional follow-up; no randomized parallel arm; 43 glucose and triglyceride pairs.
evidence_use.measurement: units specified per endpoint; pediatric leptin already log10(pg/mL)
evidence_use.reason: Use every supplied mean, sample SD, distribution and endpoint pair count as a same-population A0 reconstruction input. Rounded sample moments are plug-in population moments, with finite synthetic sample variation. Positive measurements use lognormal parameters derived from arithmetic moments, and leptin stays on the supplied log10 scale. These target-derived marginals do not independently validate any joint structure or analysis.

evidence_use.population: 44 completers aged 7-14 with simple obesity; before/after 3-month home diet/exercise program with professional follow-up; no randomized parallel arm; 43 glucose and triglyceride pairs.
evidence_use.reason: Generate 44 paired completers, with 44 leptin/body-mass pairs and 43 glucose/triglyceride pairs at evaluation n. Scale complete-pair counts as round(endpoint_n*n/44). Put unavailable pairs in final synthetic rows as the schema requires; both-null fields represent unavailable complete analysis pairs, not native missing-cell claims. Preserve one cohort with two visits, without fabricating an untreated comparator, participant ages or causal effects.

components.name: Shared marginal measurement model
components.source_to_target_assumptions: All scenarios use the same normal leptin_log10 and lognormal body_mass/glucose/triglycerides margins. For arithmetic mean m and SD s, log variance=log(1+(s/m)^2) and log mean=log(m)-log variance/2. No realized marginal matching, dependence fitting or seed selection. Sampling error, rounding and uncertainty about distribution shape are not separately modeled.

components.name: Parent shared trajectories
components.source_to_target_assumptions: target preserves the parent construction: pre=P; post=0.8*P+sqrt(0.36)*I, where independent P and I have unit variances and exchangeable off-diagonal covariance 0.25. Latent within-endpoint pre/post correlation is 0.80; cross-endpoint same-visit correlation is 0.25; cross-endpoint cross-visit correlation is 0.20. Numerical source feedback showed marginal/procedural compatibility, not evidence for these constants.

components.name: Stable shared trait mechanism
components.source_to_target_assumptions: stable_shared_trait uses pre=sqrt(0.8)*T+sqrt(0.2)*E0 and post=sqrt(0.8)*T+sqrt(0.2)*E1. T has unit variances and exchangeable cross-endpoint covariance 0.3125; E0/E1 are independent standard normal endpoint vectors. Hence latent temporal correlation remains 0.80 and same-visit cross-endpoint correlation remains 0.25, while cross-visit cross-endpoint correlation is 0.25. Standardized latent changes have independent endpoint deviations because the common trait cancels. Independence of deviations is explicitly assumed, not inferred from missing evidence. Unequal SDs and nonlinear measurement transforms can leave observed change dependence.

components.name: Discordant response mechanism
components.source_to_target_assumptions: discordant_response uses pre=sqrt(0.7)*L-sqrt(0.3)*D and post=sqrt(0.7)*L+sqrt(0.3)*D. Independent L and D have unit variances; L has exchangeable off-diagonal covariance 0.25; D has covariance 0.5*I+0.5*s*s.T with endpoint loadings s=(+1,+1,-1,-1) in schema endpoint order. Latent temporal correlation is 0.40. Positive/negative response coupling contrasts leptin/body mass with glucose/triglycerides. This partition and all constants are deliberately explicit unvalidated sensitivity assumptions, not biological facts or inferred target directions. The independent-factor construction ensures positive definite joint covariance.

components.name: Synthetic identities and complete-pair accounting
components.source_to_target_assumptions: New context/seed-prefixed keys. Exchangeable generated rows precede deterministic final-row masking. Missingness is a representation convention rather than a clinical mechanism. Local numpy.random.default_rng(seed) only, no generator I/O or evidence mutation; columns use schema order.

scenarios.assumption: Shared persistent trajectories with latent temporal correlation 0.80 and shared cross-endpoint variation of 0.25 at both visits.
scenarios.inclusion_rationale: Retain the parent as a continuity anchor. Its shared cross-endpoint variation also enters change variation. Source checks support marginal implementation only. This scenario helps contrast shared change variation against stable trait cancellation without changing marginal inputs. Cohort allocation is a fixed resource rule, not a posterior probability.
